docs.title: Welcome to My Academic Site
docs.text:
Welcome! I'm Dr. Ifeanyi Oguamah, a Senior Lecturer at the Department of Petroleum Engineering, Federal University of Technology, Owerri (FUTO).

This website provides my lecture notes, publications, and research projects on: - Reservoir Engineering - Asphaltene Molecular Dynamics Simulation - Gas-to-Liquids Technology - Environmentally Friendly Flow Assurance Methods

If you have difficulty accessing the files, check the comment section or email: 📧 ifeanyi.oguamah@futo.edu.ng

docs.title: About Me
docs.text:
I am Dr. Ifeanyi Oguamah, a Senior Lecturer in the Department of Petroleum Engineering at the Federal University of Technology, Owerri (FUTO), Nigeria. I hold a Ph.D. in Petroleum Engineering (Reservoir Engineering) and have over a decade of experience in teaching, research, and industry-oriented problem solving within the oil and gas sector.

My academic work bridges fundamental petroleum engineering principles with advanced computational and experimental techniques, with particular emphasis on reservoir fluids, asphaltene behaviour, enhanced oil recovery, and sustainable energy solutions.

docs.title: Academic Background
docs.text:
I obtained my Ph.D. and M.Sc. degrees in Petroleum Engineering from the University of Ibadan, Nigeria, where my doctoral research focused on:

Phase behaviour and prediction of asphaltene onset pressure during gas injection in oil reservoirs

I also hold a B.Sc. degree in Chemical Engineering from the Federal University of Technology, Owerri (FUTO).

docs.title: Research Interests
docs.text:
My research interests include:

  • Reservoir Engineering and Reservoir Fluid Characterisation
  • Asphaltene Phase Behaviour and Molecular Dynamics Simulation
  • Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) Techniques
  • Equation of State (EOS) Development
  • Gas-to-Liquids (GTL) Technology
  • Flow Assurance and Formation Damage
  • Data Science and Modelling Applications in Petroleum Engineering

I actively apply molecular modelling, statistical analysis, and experimental techniques to address practical challenges in hydrocarbon production and energy sustainability.

docs.title: Teaching Experience
docs.text:
I have taught undergraduate and postgraduate courses in Petroleum Engineering at Afe Babalola University, Ado-Ekiti, and currently at the Federal University of Technology, Owerri (FUTO).

Courses taught include:

  • Reservoir Engineering
  • Petroleum Production Engineering I & II
  • Natural Gas Engineering
  • Enhanced Oil Recovery
  • Petroleum Process Technology
  • Alternative Energy Sources
  • Well Testing and Reservoir Performance Analysis

My teaching philosophy emphasizes clarity, application, and independent problem-solving, ensuring students develop both theoretical understanding and practical competence.

docs.title: Publications and Scholarly Output
docs.text:
I have published in peer-reviewed international journals, including the Journal of Petroleum Science and Engineering, Arabian Journal of Chemistry, SPE Journal, Scientific African, and Clean Technologies and Environmental Policy.

My research covers: - Asphaltene precipitation and aggregation - Enhanced oil recovery using novel materials - Reservoir performance prediction - Drilling fluid formulation using environmentally friendly materials - Sustainable energy technologies for Africa

A full list of publications is available on the Publications page of this website.
